title: 锁为什么慢：写缓冲、失效队列和内存屏障
summary: 从「加锁不只是只许一个线程进」讲到硬件：一条原子指令抢缓存行、一条 release 把前面的写发出去、一条 acquire 把后面的读拦住。把缓存行、写缓冲、失效队列、四种重排、四类屏障、acquire/release 逐个拆开，并用本机实测把四笔账分开：无竞争锁 ~9 ns、seq_cst 原子加一 7.2 ns、伪共享慢 20 倍、内核唤醒 1.8 µs。
sources: Paul E. McKenney · Memory Barriers: a Hardware View for Software Hackers（经 Daniel Näslund 的逐节重述：写缓冲、失效队列、MESI、x86-64 只允许 StoreLoad、ARMv7 四种都可能）https://dannas.name/2020/06/19/memory-barriers
Linux 内核文档 · memory-barriers.txt（编译器屏障、通用/读/写屏障、acquire-release 配对、multicopy atomicity、「栈和全局」作为根的讨论）https://www.kernel.org/doc/html/latest/core-api/wrappers/memory-barriers.html

Linux 内核源码 · arch/arm64/include/asm/barrier.h（smp_mb = dmb ish，smp_rmb = dmb ishld，smp_wmb = dmb ishst，store-release = stlr，load-acquire = ldar）https://git.kernel.org/pub/scm/linux/kernel/git/torvalds/linux.git/plain/arch/arm64/include/asm/barrier.h

Jeff Preshing · Memory Barriers Are Like Source Control Operations + Acquire and Release Semantics（四种屏障；StoreLoad 是唯一能挡住 r1=r2=0 的；acquire/release 各自挡住哪些重排）https://preshing.com/20120710/memory-barriers-are-like-source-control-operations/ https://preshing.com/20120913/acquire-and-release-semantics/
Intel SDM · LOCK 与 MFENCE（LOCK 让处理器独占共享内存，P6 之后改为锁缓存；MFENCE 保证之前的读写全局可见）https://www.felixcloutier.com/x86/lock https://www.felixcloutier.com/x86/mfence
futex(2) man page（无竞争时原子指令完全在用户态执行、内核不保存锁状态；抢不到才进内核阻塞）https://man7.org/linux/man-pages/man2/futex.2.html
JSR 133 (Java Memory Model) FAQ（重排的三个来源；as-if-serial；release 刷新 / acquire 失效的说法是「若干可能效果的简写」；volatile 写=release 读=acquire）https://www.cs.umd.edu/~pugh/java/memoryModel/jsr-133-faq.html
JEP 374 · Deprecate and Disable Biased Locking（偏向锁的目的就是省掉无竞争加锁时的那条 CAS）https://openjdk.org/jeps/374
James Bornholt · Memory Consistency Models: A Tutorial（TSO 与 happens-before 的定义）https://www.cs.utexas.edu/~bornholt/post/memory-models.html

本机实测（Apple M1 Max，8 性能核 + 2 能效核，128 字节缓存行，Apple clang 15 -O2，5 次运行）：mutex 无竞争 8.7–9.4 ns/对；atomic RMW relaxed 2.2 ns、seq_cst 7.1–7.3 ns；store relaxed 0.50 ns、seq_cst 0.54–0.59 ns；load relaxed 0.32–0.34 ns、acquire 0.51–0.52 ns；空转 full fence +0.2 ns
本机实测：4 线程各占一行计数器 ~1700 M 次/秒，同一计数器 70–95 M 次/秒；1/2/4 线程抢同一把锁 8.7 / 12–15 / 14–28 ns 每次；管道 ping-pong 单次内核唤醒 1.8–2.1 µs
本机实测：同一段 C 代码用 clang -O2 编到 arm64 与 x86-64 —— relaxed store str/mov、release store stlr/mov、acquire load ldapr/mov、full fence dmb ish/mfence、seq_cst 加一 ldaddal/lock xadd
